answer: The design leans on bond keyed to a hardware root, reset on any identity-link attempt, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. By the summit of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Work waits on the dune until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the pearl of the next round. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short.
